Kai M.: Heads-up — onboarding hit a weird SDK vs REST mismatch in the Go SDK while wiring the CSV importer. REST bulk embeddings work fine but the Go client sends `input` as a single JSON string and drops metadata keys.

Kai M.: REST repro (works):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-embedding-1","inputs":[{"text":"row1","id":"r1"},{"text":"row2","id":"r2"}]}' | jq
```

Kai M.: Go SDK (fails / mangles):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
items := []string{"row1","row2"}
_, err := client.Embeddings.Create(context.Background(), redwood.EmbeddingParams{Model: "open-embedding-1", Input: items})
// error: 400 invalid_request: invalid input type
```

Lena H.: Did the Go client ever support structured inputs with ids? I thought we only had single string path initially.

Kai M.: Network capture: POST /v1/embeddings with body `{"input":"[row1 row2]"}` and metadata lost. Also noticed retries: hosted returned 429 + Retry-After:3, but SDK retried immediately twice. That caused duplicate ingestion of two rows (idempotency broken).

Marcus J.: Ok this is two separate issues: (A) shape/field parity (inputs vs input + structured entries), (B) retry semantics/Retry-After handling. Both need fixes. Which SDK version?

Kai M.: go-sdk v0.4.0. Sample-app CI complained: `embeddings_bulk_should_accept_structured_inputs` failed in integration.

Doc Bot: ci/sample-app: run failed 1799500102 - test: embeddings_bulk_should_accept_structured_inputs -> 400

Lena H.: Plan: 1) Add Embeddings.Bulk(...) helper to Go + preserve structured inputs (accept []map[string]string or []EmbeddingItem). 2) Fix serializer to send `inputs` key when array passed and avoid stringifying slices. 3) Update retry middleware to honor Retry-After and expose a RetryCallback config so apps can cancel retries. 4) Add a small e2e that posts two structured items and asserts server received array with ids.

Marcus J.: I'll open the GH issue, tag `sdk-parity` and `regression`. Also add a small changelog note: non-breaking add bulk method, behavior change for retries (now honors Retry-After).

Kai M.: For the short term I'll patch the CSV importer to call the REST bulk endpoint directly and preserve ids. Will paste the curl snippet into the onboarding docs.

Lena H.: Thanks. Also add a manual test to the onboarding checklist so new hires catch this during sample-app runs.

Kai M.: Done, pushed docs patch and created issue linking this thread. :thumbsup:
